# third_party/d3d12_agility: the D3D12 Agility SDK (SPEC §22, Microsoft redistributable), a
# prebuilt entry of third_party/vendor.toml (DENG-390, DENG-285). The headers (MIT, LICENSE) and
# the DLL licence (LICENSE.txt) are committed; D3D12Core.dll and d3d12SDKLayers.dll of host
# windows-x64 are extracted into <build>/prebuilt/d3d12_agility/ at configure time by
# de_prebuilt_import (cmake/DePrebuilt.cmake). No binary is ever committed.
#
# Only for builds with the D3D12 backend (DE_HAS_GPU_D3D12, Windows targets): other builds
# download nothing.
#
# de_tp_d3d12_agility (INTERFACE): the headers, as a SYSTEM include directory. Engine code that
# includes <d3d12.h> links it; its directory comes before the Windows SDK's, so the Agility
# d3d12.h wins over the older copy in the SDK (src/gpu/d3d12/d3d12_internal.h checks the version).
#
# de_d3d12_agility_deploy(<target>): copies the two DLLs into <target dir>/D3D12/ after each build
# of an executable that creates D3D12 devices, and makes sure the executable defines the Agility
# exports (src/gpu/d3d12/d3d12_agility_exports.h: D3D12SDKVersion and D3D12SDKPath), which point
# the D3D12 loader at that directory. Without them the OS D3D12 runtime loads (System32), where
# even the vendored WARP lacks shader model 6.6 (DENG-420). DENG-423: at the end of the calling
# directory, when no source of <target> includes d3d12_agility_exports.h, the shared generated TU
# <build>/generated/de_d3d12_agility_exports.c (which does) is added to it, so the exports cannot
# be forgotten; a target that includes the header itself keeps its own definition. The deployed
# executables are listed in <build>/de_d3d12_agility_deployed_<config>.txt, and the binary check
# agility_exports_check (tools/check_agility/) reads each one's PE export table on Windows.
# Call it from the CMakeLists.txt that defines the target (CMP0040). Defined in every build, as a
# no-op without the D3D12 backend, so callers need no guard.

# The sources of <target> that include d3d12_agility_exports.h, in <out> (generator expressions
# and files that do not exist yet are skipped).
function(de__d3d12_agility_export_sources target out)
    get_target_property(srcs ${target} SOURCES)
    get_target_property(dir ${target} SOURCE_DIR)
    set(found "")
    foreach(src IN LISTS srcs)
        if(src MATCHES "\\$<")
            continue()
        endif()
        if(NOT IS_ABSOLUTE "${src}")
            set(src "${dir}/${src}")
        endif()
        if(NOT EXISTS "${src}" OR IS_DIRECTORY "${src}")
            continue()
        endif()
        file(STRINGS "${src}" hits REGEX "#[ \t]*include[ \t]*[<\"].*d3d12_agility_exports\\.h")
        if(hits)
            list(APPEND found "${src}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    set(${out} "${found}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

# Deferred to the end of the directory that called de_d3d12_agility_deploy (every source of the
# target is known then): adds the shared export TU when no source includes the header.
function(de__d3d12_agility_ensure_exports target)
    de__d3d12_agility_export_sources(${target} found)
    if(found)
        return()
    endif()
    set(tu "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/de_d3d12_agility_exports.c")
    file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${tu}" CONTENT
        "/* Generated by third_party/d3d12_agility/CMakeLists.txt (DENG-423): the D3D12 Agility SDK\n * exports of an executable that de_d3d12_agility_deploy() deploys the runtime for. */\n#include \"${DE_ROOT_DIR}/src/gpu/d3d12/d3d12_agility_exports.h\"\n\n/* A declaration, so the TU is never empty (ISO C). */\ntypedef int de__d3d12_agility_exports_tu;\n"
        @ONLY)
    target_sources(${target} PRIVATE "${tu}")
    set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY DE_D3D12_AGILITY_EXPORTS_TU ON)
endfunction()

# Deferred to the end of the top-level directory: writes the deployed executables, one path per
# line, to <build>/de_d3d12_agility_deployed_<config>.txt for agility_exports_check.
function(de__d3d12_agility_write_manifest)
    get_property(targets GLOBAL PROPERTY DE__D3D12_AGILITY_TARGETS)
    set(content "")
    foreach(t IN LISTS targets)
        string(APPEND content "$<TARGET_FILE:${t}>\n")
    endforeach()
    file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/de_d3d12_agility_deployed_$<CONFIG>.txt"
         CONTENT "${content}")
endfunction()

function(de_d3d12_agility_deploy target)
    if(NOT DE_D3D12_AGILITY_BIN_DIR OR NOT TARGET ${target})
        return()
    endif()
    get_target_property(scheduled ${target} DE__D3D12_AGILITY_DEPLOYED)
    if(NOT scheduled)
        set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY DE__D3D12_AGILITY_DEPLOYED ON)
        get_property(manifest_scheduled GLOBAL PROPERTY DE__D3D12_AGILITY_MANIFEST)
        if(NOT manifest_scheduled)
            set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY DE__D3D12_AGILITY_MANIFEST ON)
            cmake_language(DEFER DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" CALL
                           de__d3d12_agility_write_manifest)
        endif()
        set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY DE__D3D12_AGILITY_TARGETS ${target})
        # DEFER evaluates its arguments when the call runs: bind the target name now.
        cmake_language(EVAL CODE
            "cmake_language(DEFER CALL de__d3d12_agility_ensure_exports [[${target}]])")
    endif()
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>/D3D12"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different
                "${DE_D3D12_AGILITY_BIN_DIR}/D3D12Core.dll"
                "${DE_D3D12_AGILITY_BIN_DIR}/d3d12SDKLayers.dll"
                "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>/D3D12/"
        COMMENT "Copying the D3D12 Agility SDK runtime next to ${target}"
        VERBATIM)
endfunction()

set(DE_D3D12_AGILITY_BIN_DIR "" CACHE INTERNAL "Directory of the Agility D3D12Core.dll")
if(NOT DE_HAS_GPU_D3D12)
    return()
endif()

add_library(de_tp_d3d12_agility INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(de_tp_d3d12_agility SYSTEM INTERFACE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/native/include")
set_target_properties(de_tp_d3d12_agility PROPERTIES FOLDER "dengine/third_party")

include(DePrebuilt)
de_prebuilt_import(d3d12_agility OPTIONAL)
if(DE_PREBUILT_D3D12_AGILITY_FOUND)
    set(DE_D3D12_AGILITY_BIN_DIR "${DE_PREBUILT_D3D12_AGILITY_DIR}/build/native/bin/x64"
        CACHE INTERNAL "Directory of the Agility D3D12Core.dll")
else()
    # Not windows-x64 (for example a future Windows arm64 target): the executables run on the
    # D3D12 runtime of the OS, which may lack features the backend reports as missing.
    message(STATUS "d3d12_agility: no Agility runtime for this target; using the OS D3D12 runtime")
endif()
